contribution.position: Holding my earlier position on the reliability axis: the change is not ready. I am answering qa, who claims error_rate is 0.4% per artifact:perf-report — but that artifact actually reports 3.4% at peak load against a 1% budget, and no artifact in the list contains a 0.4% figure, so qa's anchor does not support the claim; the discrepancy is a citation error, not new evidence. A new anchor I did not cite before strengthens the same axis: artifact:incident-log records two sev2 incidents last quarter, both traced to retry storms — exactly the kind of peak-load failure mode the perf report's 3.4% overshoot suggests is still live and that artifact:test-report (412 passed, 87% coverage) does not exercise. Until peak-load behavior is measured inside budget or a mitigation for retry storms is documented, the reliability evidence points against readiness.
